panels.scene: A woman walking toward the spring carrying a large clay water jar. Teaches: τις (indefinite 'a certain'); γυνή, πηγή, ὑδρία.
panels.greekCaption: γυνή τις ἔρχεται ἀπὸ τῆς κώμης πρὸς τὴν πηγήν. φέρει ὑδρίαν ἀντλῆσαι ὕδωρ.
panels.englishCaption: A certain woman comes from the village to the spring. She carries a jar to draw water.

captionTranslations.es: Una cierta mujer viene de la aldea al manantial. Lleva un cántaro para sacar agua.
captionTranslations.pl: Pewna kobieta przychodzi z wioski do źródła. Niesie dzban, żeby czerpać wodę.
captionTranslations.fil: May babaeng nagmula sa nayon patungo sa bukal. Nagdadala siya ng tapayan para kumuha ng tubig.

panels.scene: Jacob rising and greeting the woman. Reinforces: ἐγείρομαι, ἀσπάζομαι.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ Ἰάκωβος ἐγείρεται καὶ ἀσπάζεται αὐτήν.
panels.englishCaption: Jacob rises and greets her.

captionTranslations.es: Jacob se levanta y la saluda.
captionTranslations.pl: Jakub wstaje i pozdrawia ją.
captionTranslations.fil: Bumangon si Jacob at binati niya siya.

panels.scene: Jacob gesturing toward the spring and himself, asking her to draw water for them. Teaches: ἡμεῖς/ἡμῖν; reinforces διψάω, ἀντλέω.
panels.greekCaption: "διψῶ — δύνασαι ἀντλεῖν ὕδωρ ἡμῖν;"
panels.englishCaption: "I am thirsty — are you able to draw water for us?"

captionTranslations.es: «Tengo sed — ¿puedes sacar agua para nosotros?»
captionTranslations.pl: «Pragnę — czy możesz czerpać wodę dla nas?»
captionTranslations.fil: "Nauuhaw ako — kaya mo bang kumuha ng tubig para sa amin?"

panels.scene: The woman drawing water and offering it to Jacob. A simple act of kindness. Reinforces: ἀντλέω, παρέχω.
panels.greekCaption: ἡ γυνὴ ἀντλεῖ ὕδωρ καὶ παρέχει αὐτὸ τῷ Ἰακώβῳ.
panels.englishCaption: The woman draws water and provides it to Jacob.

captionTranslations.es: La mujer saca agua y se la ofrece a Jacob.
captionTranslations.pl: Kobieta czerpie wodę i daje ją Jakubowi.
captionTranslations.fil: Kumukuha ng tubig ang babae at ibinibigay niya ito kay Jacob.

panels.scene: Jacob drinking from a clay cup, then holding the jar for the donkey to drink. Reinforces: πίνω, παρέχω.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ Ἰάκωβος πίνει· καὶ παρέχει ὕδωρ τῷ ὄνῳ ἵνα καὶ αὐτὸς πίνῃ.
panels.englishCaption: Jacob drinks and provides water to the donkey so that he also may drink.

captionTranslations.es: Jacob bebe y le da agua al asno para que también beba.
captionTranslations.pl: Jakub pije i daje wodę osłu, żeby i on mógł pić.
captionTranslations.fil: Umiinom si Jacob at nagbibigay ng tubig sa asno para uminom din ito.

panels.scene: The woman introducing herself — Salome. Teaches: Σαλώμη; reinforces ὄνομα.
panels.greekCaption: "τί ὄνομά σοί ἐστιν;" — "τὸ ὄνομά μού ἐστιν Σαλώμη."
panels.englishCaption: "What is your name?" — "My name is Salome."

captionTranslations.es: «¿Cuál es tu nombre?» — «Mi nombre es Salomé.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Jak masz na imię?» — «Moje imię to Salome.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Ano ang pangalan mo?" — "Salome ang pangalan ko."

panels.scene: Close on Jacob's face, mouth open, beginning to speak earnestly. Teaches: στόμα.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ Ἰάκωβος ἀνοίγει τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ καὶ λέγει.
panels.englishCaption: Jacob opens his mouth and speaks.

captionTranslations.es: Jacob abre su boca y habla.
captionTranslations.pl: Jakub otwiera swoje usta i mówi.
captionTranslations.fil: Binubuksan ni Jacob ang kanyang bibig at nagsalita.

panels.scene: Two-panel image: a hungry person eating bread; a thirsty person drinking water. Teaches: ὅταν.
panels.greekCaption: "ὅταν πεινᾷ ἄνθρωπος, ἐσθίει ἄρτον· ὅταν δὲ διψᾷ, πίνει ὕδωρ."
panels.englishCaption: "Whenever a person hungers, he eats bread; whenever he thirsts, he drinks water."

captionTranslations.es: «Cuando una persona tiene hambre come pan; cuando tiene sed bebe agua.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Kiedy człowiek jest głodny, je chleb; kiedy pragnie, pije wodę.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Kapag nagugutom ang tao, kumakain siya ng tinapay; kapag nauuhaw, umiinom siya ng tubig."

panels.scene: A loaf of bread and a cup of water side by side. Teaches: βρῶμα, πόμα.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ ἄρτος ἐστὶν βρῶμα τοῦ σώματος. τὸ ὕδωρ ἐστὶν πόμα τοῦ σώματος.
panels.englishCaption: Bread is food of the body. Water is drink of the body.

captionTranslations.es: El pan es alimento del cuerpo. El agua es bebida del cuerpo.
captionTranslations.pl: Chleb jest pokarmem ciała. Woda jest napojem ciała.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang tinapay ay pagkain ng katawan. Ang tubig ay inumin ng katawan.

panels.scene: Jacob gesturing toward bread and water (physical) with one hand, the other raised toward the sky (spiritual). Teaches: πνεῦμα.
panels.greekCaption: "ἀλλὰ οἶδα ἄλλο βρῶμα καὶ ἄλλο πόμα — τοῦ πνεύματος."
panels.englishCaption: "But I know another food and another drink — of the spirit."

captionTranslations.es: «Pero conozco otro alimento y otra bebida — del espíritu.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Ale znam inny pokarm i inny napój — ducha.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Ngunit alam ko ang isa pang pagkain at inumin — ng espiritu."

panels.scene: A human figure with two zones — physical body and a soft inner glow (spirit). Reinforces: σῶμα, πνεῦμα.
panels.greekCaption: "ἄνθρωπος ἔχει σῶμα καὶ πνεῦμα."
panels.englishCaption: "A person has body and spirit."

captionTranslations.es: «Una persona tiene cuerpo y espíritu.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Człowiek ma ciało i ducha.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Ang tao ay may katawan at espiritu."

panels.scene: Jacob with hands raised in prayer, face lifted toward warm light. Teaches: προσκυνέω, ἀλήθεια.
panels.greekCaption: "προσκυνοῦμεν τὸν θεὸν ἐν πνεύματι καὶ ἀληθείᾳ."
panels.englishCaption: "We worship God in spirit and truth."

captionTranslations.es: «Adoramos a Dios en espíritu y verdad.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Wielbimy Boga w duchu i prawdzie.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Sinasamba natin ang Diyos sa espiritu at katotohanan."

panels.scene: Salome's face showing confusion and curiosity. Teaches: ῥῆμα.
panels.greekCaption: ἡ Σαλώμη θαυμάζει· "οὐ γινώσκω ταῦτα τὰ ῥήματα."
panels.englishCaption: Salome wonders: "I do not know these words."

captionTranslations.es: Salomé se pregunta: «No conozco estas palabras.»
captionTranslations.pl: Salome dziwi się: «Nie znam tych słów.»
captionTranslations.fil: Nagtataka si Salome: "Hindi ko alam ang mga salitang ito."

panels.scene: Warm diffuse light — no form, no body. Reinforces: πνεῦμα, θεός.
panels.greekCaption: "ὁ θεὸς πνεῦμά ἐστιν· σῶμα οὐκ ἔχει."
panels.englishCaption: "God is spirit — he does not have a body."

captionTranslations.es: «Dios es espíritu — no tiene cuerpo.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Bóg jest duchem — nie ma ciała.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Ang Diyos ay espiritu — wala siyang katawan."

panels.scene: Jacob's hand pointing upward with certainty. Teaches: θέλημα.
panels.greekCaption: "τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ."
panels.englishCaption: "This is the will of God."

captionTranslations.es: «Esta es la voluntad de Dios.»
captionTranslations.pl: «To jest wola Boża.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Ito ang kalooban ng Diyos."

panels.scene: Jacob with hand on his heart, speaking with conviction. Teaches: πιστεύω, Ἰησοῦς.
panels.greekCaption: "πιστεύω εἰς τὸν θεὸν — καὶ πιστεύω εἰς Ἰησοῦν."
panels.englishCaption: "I believe in God — and I believe in Jesus."

captionTranslations.es: «Creo en Dios — y creo en Jesús.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Wierzę w Boga — i wierzę w Jezusa.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Naniniwala ako sa Diyos — at naniniwala ako kay Hesus."

panels.scene: Warm light from above with a hand reaching down — reverent, no face. Teaches: υἱός.
panels.greekCaption: "ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ."
panels.englishCaption: "Jesus is the Son of God."

captionTranslations.es: «Jesús es el Hijo de Dios.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Jezus jest Synem Bożym.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Si Hesus ang Anak ng Diyos."

panels.scene: Jacob standing straight, hand on heart, declaring his identity. Teaches: χριστιανός, χριστός.
panels.greekCaption: "ἐγώ εἰμι χριστιανός — ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ χριστός."
panels.englishCaption: "I am a Christian — Jesus is the Christ."

captionTranslations.es: «Soy cristiano — Jesús es el Cristo.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Jestem chrześcijaninem — Jezus jest Chrystusem.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Ako ay isang Kristiyano — si Hesus ang Cristo."

panels.scene: A loaf of bread bathed in warm golden light — luminous, transcendent. Teaches: ζωή.
panels.greekCaption: "ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ ἄρτος τῆς ζωῆς."
panels.englishCaption: "Jesus is the bread of life."

captionTranslations.es: «Jesús es el pan de la vida.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Jezus jest chlebem życia.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Si Hesus ang tinapay ng buhay."

panels.scene: A cup of water glowing with light, overflowing. A person drinking with complete satisfaction. Teaches: ὅστις.
panels.greekCaption: "ὅστις πίνει τοῦτο τὸ ὕδωρ οὐκέτι διψᾷ."
panels.englishCaption: "Whoever drinks this water no longer thirsts."

captionTranslations.es: «Quien bebe esta agua ya no tiene sed.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Kto pije tę wodę, już nie będzie pragnął.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Ang sinumang umiinom ng tubig na ito ay hindi na mauuhaw."

panels.scene: A road stretching into warm golden light — clear, straight, inviting. Reinforces: ὁδός in its metaphorical sense.
panels.greekCaption: "ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ἡ ὁδὸς καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια καὶ ἡ ζωή."
panels.englishCaption: "Jesus is the way and the truth and the life."

captionTranslations.es: «Jesús es el camino, la verdad y la vida.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Jezus jest drogą, prawdą i życiem.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Si Hesus ang daan at ang katotohanan at ang buhay."

panels.scene: A fork in the road — one path leads to warm light, the other descends into shadow. Teaches: δύο, μία, θάνατος.
panels.greekCaption: "ὁδοὶ δύο εἰσίν· μία τῆς ζωῆς καὶ μία τοῦ θανάτου."
panels.englishCaption: "There are two roads — one of life and one of death."

captionTranslations.es: «Hay dos caminos — uno de vida y uno de muerte.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Są dwie drogi — jedna życia i jedna śmierci.»
captionTranslations.fil: "May dalawang daan — isa ng buhay at isa ng kamatayan."

panels.scene: Salome sitting still, mouth closed, eyes wide and thoughtful. Teaches: σιγάω, οὐδέν.
panels.greekCaption: ἡ Σαλώμη σιγᾷ· οὐδὲν λέγει.
panels.englishCaption: Salome is silent and says nothing.

captionTranslations.es: Salomé está callada y no dice nada.
captionTranslations.pl: Salome milczy i nic nie mówi.
captionTranslations.fil: Tumatahimik si Salome at walang sinasabi.

panels.scene: A grapevine growing near the spring, branches spreading with clusters of grapes. Teaches: ἄμπελος.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ Ἰάκωβος βλέπει ἄμπελον ἐγγὺς τῆς πηγῆς.
panels.englishCaption: Jacob sees a vine near the spring.

captionTranslations.es: Jacob ve una vid cerca del manantial.
captionTranslations.pl: Jakub widzi winorośl blisko źródła.
captionTranslations.fil: Nakikita ni Jacob ang isang ubas malapit sa bukal.

panels.scene: Close-up of the vine: trunk clearly visible, branches extending with clusters of grapes. Teaches: κλῆμα.
panels.greekCaption: ἡ ἄμπελος ἔχει κλήματα· τὰ κλήματα φέρουσιν καρπόν.
panels.englishCaption: The vine has branches — the branches bear fruit.

captionTranslations.es: La vid tiene ramas — las ramas dan fruto.
captionTranslations.pl: Winorośl ma gałęzie — gałęzie przynoszą owoc.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang ubas ay may mga sanga — ang mga sanga ay nagbubunga.

panels.scene: A healthy branch attached to the vine, lush and fruit-laden. Reinforces: κλῆμα, ἄμπελος, μένω, καρπός.
panels.greekCaption: "ἐὰν κλῆμα μένῃ ἐν τῇ ἀμπέλῳ, φέρει καρπὸν πολύν."
panels.englishCaption: "If a branch remains in the vine, it bears much fruit."

captionTranslations.es: «Si una rama permanece en la vid da mucho fruto.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Jeśli gałąź pozostaje w winorośli, przynosi wiele owocu.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Kung ang sanga ay nananatili sa ubas, nagbubunga ito nang sagana."

panels.scene: A broken branch lying on dry ground, withered and disconnected from the vine. Teaches: χωρίς.
panels.greekCaption: "χωρὶς τῆς ἀμπέλου τὸ κλῆμα οὐδέν ἐστιν."
panels.englishCaption: "Apart from the vine the branch is nothing."

captionTranslations.es: «Sin la vid la rama no es nada.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Bez winorośli gałąź jest niczym.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Malayo sa ubas ang sanga ay walang kabuluhan."

panels.scene: The vine bathed in light (Jesus). Above, warm light (the Father). Teaches: ἀληθινός, πατήρ.
panels.greekCaption: "ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ἡ ἄμπελος ἡ ἀληθινή· ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ ἐστιν ὁ γεωργός."
panels.englishCaption: "Jesus is the true vine — his Father is the farmer."

captionTranslations.es: «Jesús es la verdadera vid — su Padre es el agricultor.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Jezus jest prawdziwą winoroślem — jego Ojciec jest rolnikiem.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Si Hesus ang tunay na ubas — ang kanyang Ama ang magsasaka."

panels.scene: Two people facing each other with hands clasped. Teaches: ὀφείλω, ἀλλήλους.
panels.greekCaption: "ὀφείλομεν ἀγαπᾶν ἀλλήλους."
panels.englishCaption: "We ought to love one another."

captionTranslations.es: «Debemos amarnos unos a otros.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Powinniśmy miłować jeden drugiego.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Dapat tayong magmahal sa isa't isa."

panels.scene: Warm all-encompassing light — the visual for God — but now with feeling of warmth, embrace, safety. Teaches: ἀγάπη.
panels.greekCaption: "ὁ θεὸς ἀγάπη ἐστίν."
panels.englishCaption: "God is love."

captionTranslations.es: «Dios es amor.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Bóg jest miłością.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Ang Diyos ay pag-ibig."

panels.scene: Fear dissolving in warm light — darkness shrinking as love grows. Teaches: τέλειος; reinforces φόβος, ἀγάπη.
panels.greekCaption: "ἡ τελεία ἀγάπη ἔξω βάλλει τὸν φόβον."
panels.englishCaption: "Perfect love casts out fear."

captionTranslations.es: «El amor perfecto echa fuera el miedo.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Doskonała miłość wypędza strach.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Tinatanggal ng perpektong pag-ibig ang takot."

panels.scene: A figure turning away from another with a red X across the scene. Teaches: μισέω, ἀδελφός, ψεύστης.
panels.greekCaption: "ὅστις μισῇ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, ψεύστης ἐστίν."
panels.englishCaption: "If someone hates his brother, he is a liar."

captionTranslations.es: «Si alguien odia a su hermano es un mentiroso.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Kto nienawidzi swego brata, jest kłamcą.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Ang nagtatampo sa kanyang kapatid ay isang sinungaling."

panels.scene: A group of men and women standing together in a warm circle. Teaches: ἀδελφή; reinforces ἀδελφός.
panels.greekCaption: "ἀδελφοὶ καὶ ἀδελφαί" — ἡ ἐκκλησία τοῦ θεοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: "Brothers and sisters" — the family of God.

captionTranslations.es: «Hermanos y hermanas» — la familia de Dios.
captionTranslations.pl: «Bracia i siostry» — rodzina Boża.
captionTranslations.fil: "Mga kapatid na lalaki at babae" — ang pamilya ng Diyos.

panels.scene: Jacob speaking with both hands open toward Salome, palms up. Teaches: ἐντολή.
panels.greekCaption: "αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἐντολή· ἵνα ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους."
panels.englishCaption: "This is the commandment: that we love one another."

captionTranslations.es: «Este es el mandamiento: que nos amemos unos a otros.»
captionTranslations.pl: «To jest przykazanie: abyśmy miłowali jeden drugiego.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Ito ang utos: na mahalin natin ang isa't isa."

panels.scene: People with hands on their hearts, warm expressions of joy. Reinforces: χαρά, καρδία.
panels.greekCaption: "ὅταν ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους, χαρὰ μεγάλη ἐστὶν ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ἡμῶν."
panels.englishCaption: "When we love one another, great joy is in our hearts."

captionTranslations.es: «Cuando nos amamos unos a otros hay gran gozo en nuestros corazones.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Gdy miłujemy jeden drugiego, wielka radość jest w naszych sercach.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Kapag nagmamahalan tayo, may malaking kagalakan sa ating mga puso."

panels.scene: Two-panel: (A) a slave working in the field, head down; (B) friends sitting with the master, talking. Reinforces: φίλος, δοῦλος.
panels.greekCaption: "φίλοι ἐσμέν, οὐ δοῦλοι."
panels.englishCaption: "We are his friends, not slaves."

captionTranslations.es: «Somos sus amigos no esclavos.»
captionTranslations.pl: «Jesteśmy jego przyjaciółmi, nie sługami.»
captionTranslations.fil: "Mga kaibigan tayo niya, hindi mga alipin."

panels.scene: Salome's face, eyes looking down, one hand on her chest — something is changing inside her. Teaches: πλέον; reinforces σιγάω, καρδία.
panels.greekCaption: ἡ Σαλώμη σιγᾷ· τὰ ῥήματα ἐγείρει τὴν καρδίαν αὐτῆς· βούλεται γινώσκειν πλέον.
panels.englishCaption: Salome is silent — the words stir her heart — she wants to know more.

captionTranslations.es: Salomé está callada — las palabras agitan su corazón — quiere saber más.
captionTranslations.pl: Salome milczy — słowa poruszają jej serce — chce wiedzieć więcej.
captionTranslations.fil: Tumatahimik si Salome — ginugulo ng mga salita ang kanyang puso — gusto niyang malaman pa.

panels.scene: Salome leaning forward, eyes wide with genuine curiosity, mouth open mid-question.
panels.greekCaption: ἡ Σαλώμη λέγει, "τίς ἐστιν οὗτος ὁ Ἰησοῦς; βούλομαι γινώσκειν πλέον."
panels.englishCaption: Salome says, "Who is this Jesus? I want to know more."

captionTranslations.es: Salomé dice: «¿Quién es este Jesús? Quiero saber más.»
captionTranslations.pl: Salome mówi: «Kim jest ten Jezus? Chcę wiedzieć więcej.»
captionTranslations.fil: Sinabi ni Salome: "Sino ang Hesus na ito? Gusto ko pang malaman."

panels.scene: A shepherd appears on the road leading a flock of sheep past the spring.
panels.greekCaption: ποιμήν τις ἔρχεται κατὰ τὴν ὁδὸν μετὰ τῶν προβάτων αὐτοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: A certain shepherd comes along the road with his sheep.

captionTranslations.es: Un pastor viene por el camino con sus ovejas.
captionTranslations.pl: Pewien pasterz idzie drogą ze swoimi owcami.
captionTranslations.fil: May pastol na dumating sa daan kasama ang kanyang mga tupa.

panels.scene: Close on the procession: shepherd in front with staff, sheep walking close behind.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ ποιμὴν ἄγει τὰ πρόβατα· τὰ δὲ πρόβατα ἀκολουθεῖ αὐτῷ.
panels.englishCaption: The shepherd leads the sheep and the sheep follow him.

captionTranslations.es: El pastor guía a las ovejas y las ovejas lo siguen.
captionTranslations.pl: Pasterz prowadzi owce, a owce idą za nim.
captionTranslations.fil: Inaaakay ng pastol ang mga tupa at sumusunod ang mga tupa sa kanya.

panels.scene: The shepherd crouching, one hand on a sheep's head, making eye contact.
panels.greekCaption: "ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλός· ὁ καλὸς ποιμὴν γινώσκει τὰ πρόβατα αὐτοῦ."
panels.englishCaption: "Jesus is the good shepherd — the good shepherd knows his sheep."

captionTranslations.es: "Jesús es el buen pastor — el buen pastor conoce a sus ovejas."
captionTranslations.pl: "Jezus jest dobrym pasterzem — dobry pasterz zna swoje owce."
captionTranslations.fil: "Si Hesus ang mabuting pastol — kilala ng mabuting pastol ang kanyang mga tupa."

panels.scene: The shepherd standing protectively between his flock and a wolf in the distance, staff raised.
panels.greekCaption: "ὁ καλὸς ποιμὴν τίθησιν τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ὑπὲρ τῶν προβάτων."
panels.englishCaption: "The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep."

captionTranslations.es: "El buen pastor da su vida por las ovejas."
captionTranslations.pl: "Dobry pasterz oddaje swoje życie za owce."
captionTranslations.fil: "Ibinibigay ng mabuting pastol ang kanyang buhay para sa mga tupa."

panels.scene: The shepherd planted firmly facing the wolf, sheep safe behind.
panels.greekCaption: οὐ φεύγει ὅταν ὁ λύκος ἔρχηται· μένει καὶ φυλάσσει καὶ σῴζει τὰ πρόβατα.
panels.englishCaption: He does not flee when the wolf comes — he stays and guards and saves the sheep.

captionTranslations.es: No huye cuando viene el lobo — se queda y guarda y salva a las ovejas.
captionTranslations.pl: Nie ucieka gdy wilk przychodzi — pozostaje i strzeże i ocala owce.
captionTranslations.fil: Hindi siya tumakas kapag dumating ang lobo — nananatili siya at binabantayan at nililigtas ang mga tupa.

panels.scene: A hired man running away from the flock as a wolf approaches, sheep scattering.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ μισθωτὸς βλέπει τὸν λύκον καὶ φεύγει· οὐ μέλει αὐτῷ περὶ τῶν προβάτων.
panels.englishCaption: The hired worker sees the wolf and flees — the sheep do not matter to him.

captionTranslations.es: El jornalero ve al lobo y huye — las ovejas no le importan.
captionTranslations.pl: Najemnik widzi wilka i ucieka — nie obchodzą go owce.
captionTranslations.fil: Nakikita ng manggagawa ang lobo at tumakas — walang pakialam siya sa mga tupa.

panels.scene: The wolf among the flock, one sheep in its jaws, others running in all directions.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ λύκος ἁρπάζει τὰ πρόβατα καὶ σκορπίζει αὐτά.
panels.englishCaption: The wolf seizes the sheep and scatters them.

captionTranslations.es: El lobo agarra a las ovejas y las dispersa.
captionTranslations.pl: Wilk chwyta owce i rozprasza je.
captionTranslations.fil: Sinasagit ng lobo ang mga tupa at kinakalat ang mga ito.

panels.scene: Side-by-side contrast: shepherd standing firm with sheep safe; hired worker fleeing with sheep scattered.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ ποιμὴν μένει· ὁ δὲ μισθωτὸς φεύγει. τοῦτό ἐστιν ἡ διαφορά.
panels.englishCaption: The shepherd stays — but the hired worker flees. This is the difference.

captionTranslations.es: El pastor permanece — pero el jornalero huye. Esta es la diferencia.
captionTranslations.pl: Pasterz pozostaje — ale najemnik ucieka. To jest różnica.
captionTranslations.fil: Nananatili ang pastol — ngunit tumakas ang manggagawa. Ito ang pagkakaiba.

panels.scene: An open doorway in a stone sheep-pen, light streaming through, sheep entering.
panels.greekCaption: "ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ἡ θύρα τῶν προβάτων."
panels.englishCaption: "Jesus is the door of the sheep."

captionTranslations.es: "Jesús es la puerta de las ovejas."
captionTranslations.pl: "Jezus jest drzwiami owiec."
captionTranslations.fil: "Si Hesus ang pintuan ng mga tupa."

panels.scene: A figure walking through the lit doorway into safety and light.
panels.greekCaption: "ὅστις εἰσέρχεται διὰ τῆς θύρας, σῴζεται καὶ ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον."
panels.englishCaption: "Whoever enters through the door is saved and has eternal life."

captionTranslations.es: "Quien entra por la puerta es salvo y tiene vida eterna."
captionTranslations.pl: "Kto wchodzi przez drzwi, jest zbawiony i ma życie wieczne."
captionTranslations.fil: "Ang sinumang pumapasok sa pintuan ay naliligtas at may buhay na walang hanggan."

panels.scene: A figure with bowed head and heavy shoulders — the weight of sin shown through burden and posture.
panels.greekCaption: πάντες ἄνθρωποι ἔχουσιν ἁμαρτίας.
panels.englishCaption: All people have sins.

captionTranslations.es: Todas las personas tienen pecados.
captionTranslations.pl: Wszyscy ludzie mają grzechy.
captionTranslations.fil: Lahat ng tao ay may mga kasalanan.

panels.scene: A figure kneeling, mouth open, hands raised, speaking upward toward light.
panels.greekCaption: "ἐὰν ὁμολογῶμεν τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν..."
panels.englishCaption: "If we confess our sins..."

captionTranslations.es: "Si confesamos nuestros pecados..."
captionTranslations.pl: "Jeśli wyznajemy nasze grzechy..."
captionTranslations.fil: "Kung ipinagtapat natin ang ating mga kasalanan..."

panels.scene: Warm light falling on the kneeling figure, the dark burden dissolving away.
panels.greekCaption: "...ὁ θεὸς ἀφίησιν ἡμῖν καὶ καθαρίζει ἡμᾶς."
panels.englishCaption: "...God forgives us and cleanses us."

captionTranslations.es: "...Dios nos perdona y nos limpia."
captionTranslations.pl: "...Bóg nam przebacza i oczyszcza nas."
captionTranslations.fil: "...pinapatawad tayo ng Diyos at nilinis tayo niya."

panels.scene: The darkness fully gone, the figure standing clean and upright in the light.
panels.greekCaption: "...ἀπὸ πάσης ἀδικίας."
panels.englishCaption: "...from all unrighteousness."

captionTranslations.es: "...de toda maldad."
captionTranslations.pl: "...od wszelkiej nieprawości."
captionTranslations.fil: "...mula sa lahat ng kasamaan."

panels.scene: A red-tinted stream washing across a dark surface leaving it clean. Symbolic.
panels.greekCaption: "τὸ αἷμα Ἰησοῦ καθαρίζει ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ πάσης ἁμαρτίας."
panels.englishCaption: "The blood of Jesus cleanses us from all sin."

captionTranslations.es: "La sangre de Jesús nos limpia de todo pecado."
captionTranslations.pl: "Krew Jezusa oczyszcza nas z wszelkiego grzechu."
captionTranslations.fil: "Nililinis tayo ng dugo ni Hesus mula sa lahat ng kasalanan."

panels.scene: Figures lying still in shadow and darkness — lifeless, unmoving.
panels.greekCaption: χωρὶς τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐσμὲν νεκροὶ ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ἡμῶν.
panels.englishCaption: Without Jesus we are dead in our sins.

captionTranslations.es: Sin Jesús estamos muertos en nuestros pecados.
captionTranslations.pl: Bez Jezusa jesteśmy umarli w naszych grzechach.
captionTranslations.fil: Kung wala si Hesus tayo ay patay sa ating mga kasalanan.

panels.scene: A hand reaching down from light into darkness toward the still figures.
panels.greekCaption: μόνος ὁ Ἰησοῦς δύναται σῴζειν ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν.
panels.englishCaption: Only Jesus is able to save us from our sins.

captionTranslations.es: Solo Jesús puede salvarnos de nuestros pecados.
captionTranslations.pl: Tylko Jezus może nas zbawić od naszych grzechów.
captionTranslations.fil: Si Hesus lamang ang makakaligtas sa atin mula sa ating mga kasalanan.

panels.scene: Salome looking up at sunlight filtering through tree leaves, dappled light on her face.
panels.greekCaption: ἡ Σαλώμη βλέπει τὸ φῶς τοῦ ἡλίου διὰ τῶν φύλλων τοῦ δένδρου.
panels.englishCaption: Salome sees the light of the sun through the leaves of the tree.

captionTranslations.es: Salomé ve la luz del sol a través de las hojas del árbol.
captionTranslations.pl: Salome widzi światło słońca przez liście drzewa.
captionTranslations.fil: Nakikita ni Salome ang liwanag ng araw sa pamamagitan ng mga dahon ng puno.

panels.scene: A wide landscape — fields, road, village, sky — flooded with warm light.
panels.greekCaption: "ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου."
panels.englishCaption: "Jesus is the light of the world."

captionTranslations.es: "Jesús es la luz del mundo."
captionTranslations.pl: "Jezus jest światłością świata."
captionTranslations.fil: "Si Hesus ang liwanag ng mundo."

panels.scene: Figures walking in dim shadow, unable to see their way.
panels.greekCaption: χωρὶς τοῦ Ἰησοῦ οἱ ἄνθρωποι περιπατοῦσιν ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ.
panels.englishCaption: Apart from Jesus people walk in the darkness.

captionTranslations.es: Sin Jesús las personas caminan en tinieblas.
captionTranslations.pl: Bez Jezusa ludzie chodzą w ciemności.
captionTranslations.fil: Malayo kay Hesus ang mga tao ay lumalakad sa kadiliman.

panels.scene: Light breaking into the darkness — a path of light appearing where there was none.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ Ἰησοῦς δείκνυσιν ἡμῖν τὸ φῶς.
panels.englishCaption: Jesus shows us the light.

captionTranslations.es: Jesús nos muestra la luz.
captionTranslations.pl: Jezus pokazuje nam światło.
captionTranslations.fil: Ipinapakita sa atin ni Hesus ang liwanag.

panels.scene: Light filling the whole frame, figures walking clearly in it.
panels.greekCaption: "τὸ φῶς φαίνει ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ καὶ φωτίζει πάντα ἄνθρωπον."
panels.englishCaption: "The light shines in the darkness and illuminates every person."

captionTranslations.es: "La luz brilla en las tinieblas e ilumina a toda persona."
captionTranslations.pl: "Światło świeci w ciemności i oświeca każdego człowieka."
captionTranslations.fil: "Sumisinag ang liwanag sa kadiliman at nagliliwanag sa bawat tao."

panels.scene: A group of people walking together in the light, side by side, connected.
panels.greekCaption: ἐν τῷ φωτὶ ἔχομεν κοινωνίαν μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ καὶ μετ᾽ ἀλλήλων.
panels.englishCaption: In the light we have fellowship with him and with one another.

captionTranslations.es: En la luz tenemos comunión con él y entre nosotros.
captionTranslations.pl: W światłości mamy wspólnotę z nim i z sobą nawzajem.
captionTranslations.fil: Sa liwanag mayroon tayong pakikiisa sa kanya at sa isa't isa.

panels.scene: A figure being lifted from the ground into standing, into light, into life.
panels.greekCaption: "ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ἡ ἀνάστασις καὶ ἡ ζωή."
panels.englishCaption: "Jesus is the resurrection and the life."

captionTranslations.es: "Jesús es la resurrección y la vida."
captionTranslations.pl: "Jezus jest zmartwychwstaniem i życiem."
captionTranslations.fil: "Si Hesus ang muling pagkabuhay at ang buhay."

panels.scene: The risen figure standing fully upright in bright endless light — no horizon, no boundary.
panels.greekCaption: "ὅστις πιστεύει εἰς αὐτὸν ζῇ καὶ ζήσει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα."
panels.englishCaption: "Whoever believes in him lives and lives for ever."

captionTranslations.es: "Quien cree en él vive y vivirá para siempre."
captionTranslations.pl: "Kto wierzy w niego, żyje i będzie żył na wieki."
captionTranslations.fil: "Ang naniniwala sa kanya ay nabubuhay at mabubuhay magpakailanman."

panels.scene: A hand reaching down from light offering a gift.
panels.greekCaption: "ὁ θεὸς δίδωσιν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἵνα ὅστις πιστεύῃ μὴ ἀποθνῄσκῃ."
panels.englishCaption: "God gives his Son so that whoever believes may not die."

captionTranslations.es: "Dios da a su Hijo para que quien crea no muera."
captionTranslations.pl: "Bóg daje swojego Syna, aby kto wierzy, nie umarł."
captionTranslations.fil: "Ibinibigay ng Diyos ang kanyang Anak upang ang naniniwala ay huwag mamatay."

panels.scene: Salome looking at Jacob, face full of wonder and internal conflict.
panels.greekCaption: ἡ Σαλώμη λέγει, "τὰ ῥήματά σου πολλά ἐστιν καὶ μεγάλα — θαυμάζω σφόδρα."
panels.englishCaption: Salome says, "Your words are many and great — but I wonder greatly."

captionTranslations.es: Salomé dice: "Tus palabras son muchas y grandes — pero me asombro mucho."
captionTranslations.pl: Salome mówi: "Twoje słowa są liczne i wielkie — ale bardzo się dziwię."
captionTranslations.fil: Sinabi ni Salome: "Marami at dakila ang iyong mga salita — ngunit lubos akong nagtataka."

panels.scene: Wide, quiet scene: sun low in the sky, everything golden-orange. The water jar sits forgotten beside the spring.
panels.greekCaption: ἡ ἑσπέρα ἔρχεται. ἡ ὑδρία ἔτι ἐστὶν παρὰ τὴν πηγήν.
panels.englishCaption: Evening comes. The water jar is still beside the spring.

captionTranslations.es: Llega la tarde. El cántaro todavía está junto al manantial.
captionTranslations.pl: Nadchodzi wieczór. Dzban wciąż jest przy źródle.
captionTranslations.fil: Dumarating ang gabi. Nandoon pa rin ang tapayan malapit sa bukal.

panels.scene: Salome sitting still, water jar untouched beside her, eyes looking at something unseen.
panels.greekCaption: ἡ Σαλώμη οὐ μεριμνᾷ περὶ τοῦ ὕδατος τῆς ὑδρίας· μεριμνᾷ δὲ περὶ τοῦ ὕδατος τῆς ζωῆς.
panels.englishCaption: Salome does not worry about the water of the jar — she thinks about the water of life.

captionTranslations.es: Salomé no se preocupa por el agua del cántaro — piensa en el agua de la vida.
captionTranslations.pl: Salome nie troszczy się o wodę w dzbanie — myśli o wodzie życia.
captionTranslations.fil: Hindi nag-aalala si Salome sa tubig ng tapayan — nag-iisip siya sa tubig ng buhay.
